points.text: Unclear whether sparse attention is applied in prefill or only decoding
Missing Needle-in-a-Haystack stress tests to support recall claim
Dynamic inference-time sparsity baselines limited mainly to Quest
Efficiency evaluated only on RTX A6000; no A100/H100 results
Figure 1 PPL/accuracy setup not specified in caption
Hadamard smoothing before quantization borrowed from QuaRot; weak novelty
Bucketization resembles standard quantization
Baselines limited to StreamingLLM and Quest; SnapKV, MInference, DuoAttention etc. missing
No justification that Manhattan distance on 2-bit codes approximates dot products
Choice of bucketization thresholds not explained
No sensitivity analysis of bucketization thresholds
Kernel efficiency analysis lacks comparison with other sparse methods
No explanation or case analysis of why results match full attention
Baselines thin; many related training-free sparse methods not compared or cited
8x sparsity claim relative to handicapped Quest; Quest configuration unstated
L1 estimator on 2-bit codes lacks theoretical bound or error analysis
No measurement of top-k or attention-mass recall versus exact or Quest
No inner-product estimator on same codes compared to justify Manhattan distance
L1 vs L2 explanation speculative; Table 7 differences look like noise
Thresholds B1-B3 choice, granularity and calibration unspecified
Unspecified: RoPE order, query quantization thresholds, which layers stay dense
GQA not discussed
w/o Hadamard ablation uses untuned thresholds; strawman
Only two old Llama-2-7B models; no GQA, larger or reasoning models
Limited tasks: six LongBench tasks, no RULER/NIAH; passkey easy and saturated
No variance or seeds reported for small differences
Claim of matching full attention at 64 tokens overstated
Perplexity lower than full attention unexplained; 2x claim undefined
Fig. 1 single unspecified setup reads as evidence
Estimation remains O(s); Hadamard and bucketization overhead omitted
Table 2 latency units likely wrong (us vs ms)
End-to-end speedups modest
Only one hardware configuration
No latency comparison against Quest or other sparse baselines
No memory savings; extra 2-bit key copy added
No batched-serving throughput evaluation
Prefill not addressed
Cache growth 1/16 statement imprecise
Novelty moderate: Hadamard rotation and compressed-key scoring established
Related work mislabels H2O and infLLM
